scope: Actual 1235 K profile and fixed-density, fixed-composition temperature projections through 70% of the original temperature. Finite species and thermal derivatives checked. The cutoff changes admission only. Cooler EOS, isotope and phase limits remain; the checks do not certify the full cooling forecast.
limitations: The cutoff is not an ionization model.
A screened binary-collision approximation in the liquid has model uncertainty of order a factor two.
Colder partially ionized trace helium is not validated.
